{{Top|leg}}
The '''Republic Census''' was a census that was carried out during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. According to the census, by the time of the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[High Galactic/Legends|High Galactic alphabet]] was used by a third of speakers of [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]]. It also revealed that the High Galactic Alphabet was used by over half of Basic speakers who came from noble backgrounds or had an income of more that 500,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Written Word">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref>
